text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I'm really looking forward to Agnes Tachyon~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She has kind of a cynical air about her, but
it feels like there's more to it than just that...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm. That's so true.
I just really love the way she runs—

Agnes Tachyon's fans
had flocked to the venue in droves!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the Tenno Sho (Autumn), renowned as
the ultimate showdown to crown the king of middle-distance races...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: While the grandstands buzzed with restless anticipation, tension hung thick over the turf.
choice_data_list: Are you getting nervous after all?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Not at all!
Excessive tension leads to a lack of focus."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Keep relaxed.
Still, I want to make the most of this chance."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I might actually be able to
make it pretty far today.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "I've finally climbed my way up here. Today, I'm taking you on...!"
